items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM in weekend summary; confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: ETR weekend injury summary optimism flipped to official active.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets lead with Adams out context.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM in ETR summary; officially INACTIVE.
items.why: Pessimistic GTD confirmed inactive after limited participation.
items.opportunity: Snap share to Braelon Allen or committee.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT per ETR weekend summary.
items.opportunity: Ravens skill upside if any, but limited.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield in snap share (50%), rush share (41%), route participation (34%); Dobbins 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Clear lead usage post-return over Dobbins/Harvey.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: arguably worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume/HVT overrides efficiency; backup better YPC in same scheme.
items.implication: Continue starting; ceiling tied to red-zone/targets not YPC.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey mild hamstring strain (returned in game); Shanahan pretty optimistic fine after bye.
items.why: Coach update post-game exit/return; bye helps.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY in ETR; confirmed ACTIVE for MNF, played limited snaps with back tweak but hamstring 'came out great' and does not expect to miss time.
items.why: Expected status held; postgame self-report optimistic on hamstring/back.
items.implication: Monitor Week 8; efficient when on field (pitch count).
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down when healthy; reverse prior handcuff boosts.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
items.why: ETR listed both OUT for MNF.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; targets elsewhere.

items.text: Josh Jacobs, Tank Dell, Jordan Mason, others IN/ACTIVE.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter confirmed multiple actives including Dell/Mason/Jacobs.
items.implication: Jacobs back in Packers backfield; Dell limited return.
items.opportunity: Jacobs RB1 role; Dell routes secondary.

items.text: Josh Jacobs is BACK; discuss fantasy value ROS for Packers RB.
items.implication: Re-elevate in rankings if volume holds.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Big game creates trade window before regression.
items.implication: Trade for safer asset; not long-term hold.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead, Tank Dell only 6 in limited return (first since 2024), others split.
items.why: Nico dominant route share; Dell minimal on return.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell not immediate threat.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rice; has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 career games.
items.why: Route lead without Rice but historical ceiling note.
items.implication: Volume play but capped upside; fade pure ceiling.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical production.
